blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCartStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates a cart to ensure it exists and is not completed.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

children.name: ValidateCartStepInput
children.description: The details of the cart to validate.
